# MacroNest.online — India Macroeconomic Indicators & Research

> MacroNest.online ("Knowledge Today, A Brighter Tomorrow") is a dedicated macroeconomic data monitor tracking Indian central banking policy rates, systemic liquidity deficit/surplus, retail and wholesale inflation prints, foreign exchange reserves, gross GST collections, and gross domestic product (GDP) metrics directly from official statutory feeds.

## Core Capabilities & Monitored Metrics
- **Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Policy Rates**: Official repo rate, Standing Deposit Facility (SDF), and Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) corridor anchors set by the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC).
- **Banking System Liquidity**: Daily systemic net liquidity deficit or surplus published by the Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL) and RBI.
- **Consumer Price Index (CPI)**: Headline and core retail inflation year-on-year prints compiled and published monthly by MoSPI.
- **Foreign Exchange (Forex) Reserves**: Weekly statistical supplement (WSS) prints of total foreign currency assets, gold, and SDR holdings.
- **Gross Goods & Services Tax (GST)**: Monthly gross nationwide collections reported by the Ministry of Finance.
- **Macroeconomic Release Calendar**: Statutory publishing windows for RBI MPC policy decisions, MoSPI data releases, and national statistics.

## Canonical URLs & Feeds
- **Homepage & Public Indicator Dashboard**: https://macronest.online/
- **Macroeconomic Release Calendar**: https://macronest.online/calendar
- **Direct Machine-Readable CSV Feed**: https://macronest.online/data/metrics.csv
- **XML Sitemap**: https://macronest.online/sitemap.xml
- **Robots Directives**: https://macronest.online/robots.txt

## Primary Official Data Sources
- Reserve Bank of India (RBI): https://www.rbi.org.in
- Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI): https://www.mospi.gov.in
- Ministry of Finance, Government of India: https://finmin.nic.in
- Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL): https://www.ccilindia.com
